conventions.native: registry hit at the pinned version: architectures[0] for vllm / sglang / llama.cpp, model_type for mlx-lm / tgi / onnx / transformers.js, either for transformers; executorch per model: the type is registered and the shape matches an export recipe's dims or holds a repo the recipes / optimum-executorch tests name (repos[r].executorch_why)
conventions.via_transformers: repos[r].via_transformers[fw] = true: the framework runs the model through its Transformers backend (vLLM _TRANSFORMERS_SUPPORTED_MODELS) or fallback (TGI, a model_type in transformers' causal-LM mapping at TGI's pin); a separate tier, not counted as native
conventions.backdoor: shapes[i].backdoor[fw].hosts: shapes j that emulate shape i under emul_matrix(mode='payable') with a natively supported, generative member (embedding / reward / classifier repos excluded by pipeline tag and architectures, drafters and checkpoint anomalies excluded: repos[r].not_a_host); the host repo of a shape is its member with the fewest host_flags (speech / audio model, vision-language wrapper, quantised checkpoint), then the most downloaded; practical hosts first (params_x <= 10; larger ones carry impractical: true), a speech / audio host last, exact edges first (mode='exact'), then the target's own model family, then a host without the wrapper / quantised flags, then by params_x
conventions.repo_backdoor: a repo whose native[fw] is not true uses shapes[repos[repo].shape].backdoor[fw]
